verdict.rationale: Kling documents a REST API reference, but its endpoints are rendered with static Bash/Python/Java samples. The doc renderer contains no try/run functionality, there is no sandbox or test environment, and no OpenAPI artifact is published. Static code samples are not an interactive reference with runnable examples, so the applicable capability is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
